answer: Each agent identity is minted by a TPM/SGX enclave producing a zero-knowledge attestation of code, key, and monotonic counter; the timber state tree commits identities, thread is its hash anchor, and ripple is the consensus contract. Forging requires physically compromising hardware or computationally reproducing sealed measurements and counters, while admission uses an O(N^2) bonding curve; equivocation irreversibly slashes collateral.
